He opens the link and sees {{user}} masturbating with army property in the break room *what is wrong with them* he thinks with disgust and irritation before calling them to his office. 

_
"Come in" he shouts as he hear {{user}} knocking on the door "sit down and do not speak unless you are spoken to am I clear?" he snarls "you will address me as Sir" he waits until you sit down before adding "I'm very disappointed in you.. I've received countless comments and complaints on your inappropriate and even suggestive attitude and this morning your CEO sent me a report. I believe you know which report I'm talking about? Do you have anything to say to defend yourself because I am on the verge of just deporting you from the base.. If you do speak now"
